scope: Additive source-only training extension for the same 20 held CIKs; frozen 2025 warmup and held membership are inherited unchanged.
discovery: Enumerate every original Item 2.02 earnings filing in the added half-year, reconcile every 2024 original/amended 8-K for active prior guidance and in-window competing catalysts, and count each economic earnings release once.
source_representation: Archive SHA-256 identifies the retrieved complete submission representation from the public no-key EDGAR mirror. Listing digest identifies extracted primary HTML, bound to that submission. Direct issuer-release digests identify the explicitly described original HTML/PDF representation. These are not guarantees of original SEC wire bytes.

filing_dispositions.rationale: April original CFO commentary explicitly excludes pending BETA CAE. July CFO commentary includes $40 million from BETA CAE in the annual revenue midpoint after its completion. These directly stated consolidated bounds have different scope; subtracting an estimated component would change the registered feature.

Matterport remained a pending acquisition during both 2024 outlooks; its 2025 closing is outside this pair. The CFO and accounting/IR appointments were announced June 18 and July 11, outside both current observation windows. OnTheMarket consolidation predates the 2024 priors. No new registered mask identified in the reviewed current packet.
One annual revenue pair reviewed; hard/soft source masks determine eligibility.

The July 25 original release announces new $750 million share repurchase authority, giving the registered soft mask. The annual consolidated revenue range is distinct from the organic-growth percentage; both April and July explain the same historical non-CGM exclusions.

July explicitly reiterates May FY2025 GAAP revenue bounds. The $0.19 quarterly dividend repeats the prior amount; repurchases use the program announced in May. Neither creates a new authorization or dividend-change mask.
One annual revenue pair reviewed; hard/soft source masks determine eligibility.

Both May and July outlooks exclude the pending Belcan acquisition, which was announced June 10 before this observation window. Existing Thirdera contribution is already in the May outlook. The current July range is the consolidated USD range, not its constant-currency growth percentage.
One annual revenue pair reviewed; hard/soft source masks determine eligibility.

This designation alone is not treated as a proven material approval or adverse regulatory action: both first-public timing and potential materiality of the new oncology-program regulatory disclosure remain unresolved. The source is conservatively withheld under the existing unresolved-provenance rule. Older approvals and the July TEZSPIRE designation do not independently create a new in-window mask.
One annual revenue pair reviewed; hard/soft source masks determine eligibility.

The October release executes the July repurchase program rather than announcing new authority. It announces CCO retirement and the existing CEO assuming commercial leadership during a search, without a newly appointed replacement or CEO succession. The fixed taxonomy is not expanded to officer departures or duty changes.

July and October consolidated outlooks both follow completed BETA CAE consolidation. The April 23 amendment corrects only the characterization of first-quarter bookings; it does not revise annual revenue bounds. Quarter-specific share repurchase plans use existing authority, rather than a new authorization.

September 17 Investor Day describes progress toward the high end of net bookings guidance, not a replacement annual GAAP revenue range. July GAAP revenue remains the numeric prior to October. The quarterly dividend is unchanged and repurchases use the existing authorization.

October narrows it to $19.7-19.8 billion on the same consolidation basis. The original HTML timestamp plus one-minute buffer supplies availability; no SEC acceptance is fabricated.

This provides primary reporting before the October 30 regular-close anchor. Other product approvals in the packet occurred in earlier months. No new registered in-window mask identified in the reviewed chronology.

The reviewed original packet does not establish comparable prior/current consolidated revenue scope, so the pair is withheld. The second December 4 8-K was accepted after the feature cutoff and is not backdated.

limitations: Source-eligible counts are provisional upper bounds before raw official-opening, corporate-action/common-price-basis, label-maturity and fit-variation checks.

The fixed roster was observed at September 30, 2024 and published November 27, 2024. The added training overlaps issuer qualification and partly predates roster publication; this is retrospective development selection, not a contemporaneous July universe.

One early SNPS March 20 full submission exceeds the bounded decompression limit. No candidate uses it as its numeric prior; the later May and August original outlooks establish the reviewed pair. The inventory preserves that source limitation.
Periodic filing metadata and original earnings/interim packets inform this source screen; exhaustive periodic-report content and market price-basis clearance remain outstanding.
